title: 飛行力学Ⅰ
subtitle: Dynamics of Flight I
teachers:
HAMAMOTO Yusuke
授業科目の学習・教育目標
educationalGoal: The “dynamics of flight” is the foundation of aeronautical engineering. In this course, students will learn what kind of forces act on an aircraft in flight and learn about the balance and dynamics characteristics for stable flight.
advice:
Students will begin by learning basic mathematical knowledge and axis definitions, and learn about the six-degrees-of-freedom equation of motion.
Next, students will learn to analyze qualities of flight after learning linearization of the equation of motion.
In addition to learning design standards, students will deepen their understanding of qualities of flight by learning the basics of flight control.
requiredKnowledge:
Acquisition of Dynamics of Machines
Sufficient skill in mathematics and physics

achievementLevels.ideal:
(1) Be able to accurately explain the physical principles and characteristics of aircraft in flight.
(2) Be able to explain the effects of the main items of the aerodynamic derivative on flight motion by showing numerical values through examples.
achievementLevels.standard:
(1) Understand the principle of flight and its characteristics, and be able to explain important items.
(2) Be able to explain the effects of the main items of the aerodynamic derivative on flight motion shown by related expressions in the text, and to explain the results while looking at the text.

              The “dynamics of flight” is the foundation of aeronautical engineering. In this course, students will learn what kind of forces act on an aircraft in flight and learn about the balance and dynamics characteristics for stable flight.

              授業の概要および学習上の助言

              Students will begin by learning basic mathematical knowledge and axis definitions, and learn about the six-degrees-of-freedom equation of motion.
Next, students will learn to analyze qualities of flight after learning linearization of the equation of motion.
In addition to learning design standards, students will deepen their understanding of qualities of flight by learning the basics of flight control.
